headline: Dangote Hires Técnicas Reunidas for $4 Billion Ethiopia Fertilizer Plant
summary: Dangote Group awarded a hydrogen production equipment supply contract to Spanish engineering firm Técnicas Reunidas for its $4 billion fertilizer plant under development in Ethiopia.
why: Large-scale industrial engineering contracts drive capital goods orders and international trade flows supporting regional agricultural fertilizer manufacturing.

impacts.name: Industrial Engineering
impacts.why: Securing major engineering and equipment contracts bolsters order backlogs for industrial suppliers.
